comments.author: Archon
comments.body_html:
JailBrake the item text isAR-15 SAI JailBrake 5.56x45 muzzle device, but the small text on the item in your inventory says “Jail Break”.

Not too long ago you could put silencers on guns that had this attachment. there’s not physically enough room for that to be possible, plus it’s not how the part functions. Some people thought it was fun to use, even if the JailBrake attachment spews out so much gas you can’t see what you’re shooting at properly. It was easily the lowest recoil combo for M4.
